# Project overview
This script performs visualization of the GWAS on _Aspergillus tubingensis_ isolates. 

# Set-up parameters
```{r functions}
source(here("src", "theme.R"))
source(here("src", "GWAS_functions.R"))
```

## Set-up
First we load the GWAS data, this data is generated with GEMMA (see [`5_GWAS.ipynb`](scripts/5_GWAS.ipynb)). In short, first the VCF data was pruned to account for linkage disequillibrium, and with the pruned data Gemma was used to look for kinship (-gk 1). After that PLINK was used to determine 3 covariates and those were used as input in the GEMMA model (-c pc_covariates.txt). 

### Itraconazole
```{r read ITC, echo= F}
# Load genomic distance data (PLINK)
df = fread(glue::glue('{GWAS_results}/output/GWAS_adjustedPC_itc.assoc.txt.gz'))

scaffold_lengths <- df %>%
  group_by(chr) %>%
  summarise(length = max(ps))

# 2. Calculate the cumulative start position for each scaffold
scaffold_offsets <- scaffold_lengths %>%
  mutate(offset = lag(cumsum(as.numeric(length)), default = 0)) %>%
  select(chr, offset)

# 3. Join back to original data and add BP to the offset
itc <- df %>%
  inner_join(scaffold_offsets, by = "chr") %>%
  mutate(BP_cum = ps + offset)%>% 
  #filter(p_wald < 0.01 | runif(n()) < 0.01) %>% na.omit() %>% 
  mutate(chr = as.numeric(gsub("BLWE010000", "", chr)))

axis_set <- itc %>% 
  group_by(chr) %>% 
  summarize(center = (max(BP_cum) + min(BP_cum)) / 2)



```

### Posaconazole
```{r read POS, echo= F}
# Load genomic distance data (PLINK)
df = fread(glue::glue('{GWAS_results}/output/GWAS_adjustedPC_pos.assoc.txt.gz'))
# 3. Join back to original data and add BP to the offset
pos <- df %>%
  inner_join(scaffold_offsets, by = "chr") %>%
  mutate(BP_cum = ps + offset)%>% 
  mutate(chr = as.numeric(gsub("BLWE010000", "", chr)))

```

### Voriconazole
```{r read VRC, echo= F}
# Load genomic distance data (PLINK)
df = fread(glue::glue('{GWAS_results}/output/GWAS_adjustedPC_vrc.assoc.txt.gz'))
vrc <- df %>%
  inner_join(scaffold_offsets, by = "chr") %>%
  mutate(BP_cum = ps + offset)%>% 
  #filter(p_wald < 0.01 | runif(n()) < 0.01) %>% na.omit() %>% 
  mutate(chr = as.numeric(gsub("BLWE010000", "", chr)))

```

### Environmental & clinical divide
```{r read clinical_and_env, echo= F}
# Load genomic distance data (PLINK)
df = fread(glue::glue('{GWAS_results}/output/GWAS_PC1_origin.assoc.txt.gz'))

#Build env db
env_vs_cli <- df %>%
  inner_join(scaffold_offsets, by = "chr") %>%
  mutate(BP_cum = ps + offset)%>% 
  mutate(chr = as.numeric(gsub("BLWE010000", "", chr)))



```



# Build plots
```{r build Plots}
# Build the plot

itc_hits <- get_gene_snps(itc, genes)
pos_hits <- get_gene_snps(pos, genes)
vrc_hits <- get_gene_snps(vrc, genes)

p1 <- plot_function(itc,'Itraconazole')
p2 <- plot_function(pos,'Posaconazole')
p3 <- plot_function(vrc,'Voriconazole')

p1
p2
p3
```


The initial manhattan plots show a suspiciously high number of significant SNPs so start investigating this:
starting off with a QQ analysis.
```{r perform QQ analysis}
library(qqman)
# Generate the plot
qq(itc$p_wald, main = "QQ plot itraconazole")
qq(vrc$p_wald, main = "QQ plot voriconazole")
qq(pos$p_wald, main = "QQ plot posaconazole")

get_lambda(itc$p_wald)
get_lambda(vrc$p_wald)
get_lambda(pos$p_wald)


```
The lambda ideally should be between 0.9 and 1.1 


```{r focus}
focus_p1 <- plot_function(itc,'Itraconazole',chr_select = 8,start = 2.5e6 ,end =3.5e6)
focus_p2 <- plot_function(pos,'Posaconazole',chr_select = 8,start = 2.5e6 ,end =3.5e6)
focus_p3 <- plot_function(vrc,'Voriconazole',chr_select = 8,start = 2.5e6 ,end =3.5e6)

focus_p1
focus_p2
focus_p3

```

# Filtering for genes of interest
This looks for all genes of interest, signf p val


```{r region focus}

filt_itc <- itc %>% filter(p_wald < 1e-5)
filt_pos <- pos %>% filter(p_wald < 1e-5)
filt_vrc <- vrc %>% filter(p_wald < 1e-5)

gff3 = fread(glue::glue('{gff_data}/GCA_013340325.1_ASM1334032v1_genomic.gff'),fill = 12,skip = 7,comment.char = '#') %>% 
    mutate(chr = as.numeric(gsub("BLWE010000", "", V1))) %>% select(chr, everything()) %>% select(-V1) %>% 
    rename(start= V4, end = V5)

feature_table <- download_data()

gene_annotations <- gff3 %>%
  filter(V3 == "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract the Gene ID from the V9 attributes column
    # This regex looks for 'ID=' or 'Name=' and grabs the text until the next ';'
    gene_id = stringr::str_extract(V9, "(?<=ID=)[^;]+")
  ) %>%
  select(chr, start, end, gene_id)


genes_itc <- get_genes_of_interest(itc, gene_annotations,p_threshold = 1e-5, buffer = 0) %>% mutate(azole = 'itc')
genes_pos <- get_genes_of_interest(pos, gene_annotations,p_threshold = 1e-5, buffer = 0) %>% mutate(azole = 'pos')
genes_vrc <- get_genes_of_interest(vrc, gene_annotations,p_threshold = 1e-5, buffer = 0) %>% mutate(azole = 'vrc')

genes_of_interest = rbindlist(list(genes_itc,genes_pos,genes_vrc)) %>%
  mutate(gene_id = gsub('gene-','',gene_id)) %>% left_join(feature_table)


output_list <- left_join(genes_of_interest,feature_table) #%>% filter(beta > 0)
write.csv(output_list, glue::glue('{GWAS_results}/genes_of_interest.csv'))
hi_over <- output_list %>% select(gene_id,chr,azole,name) %>% group_by(gene_id,chr,azole,name) %>% distinct()

head(hi_over)
```





# Perform sliding window approach
```{r sliding window,fig.width=10, fig.height=5, out.width="100%"}
fst_rest_vs_sens = fread(glue::glue('{fst_data}/all_10k.windowed.weir.fst')) %>% clean_names()
fst_clin_vs_env = fread(glue::glue('{fst_data}/env_cli_10k.windowed.weir.fst'))%>% clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(clinical_n_variants = n_variants, 
         clinical_weighted_fst= weighted_fst,
         clinical_mean_fst = mean_fst) %>% 
  select(-c(n_variants,weighted_fst,mean_fst))

df_slide_window <- left_join(fst_rest_vs_sens,fst_clin_vs_env) %>% 
  mutate(chrom = as.factor(as.numeric(gsub("BLWE010000", "", chrom))))


# Plotting to see the 'peaks'
top <- ggplot(df_slide_window) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=bin_start, y=clinical_weighted_fst, color=chrom), size=0.5) + 
  facet_grid(cols=vars(chrom), scales="free", space="free") +
  theme_classic(base_size=14) + 
  ylim(-0.01, 0.61) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=0.3), lty=2, lwd=0.2) +
  theme(legend.position="none",
        panel.spacing=unit(0.01, "cm"),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.title.x=element_blank()) +
  # Adjusted scale for Mb labels
  #scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) x / 1e6) + 
  labs(y=expression(atop(Clin~vs.~Env,(Weighted~F[st])))) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    # Forces a tick at every 1,000,000 bp
    breaks = breaks_width(1e6), 
    # Converts 1000000 to "1", 2000000 to "2", etc.
    labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) # Keep blank for the top plot

# 3. Bottom Plot: Resistant vs Sensitive
bottom <- ggplot(df_slide_window) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=bin_start, y=weighted_fst, color=chrom), size=0.5) + 
  facet_grid(cols=vars(chrom), scales="free", space="free") +
  theme_classic(base_size=14) + 
  ylim(-0.01, 0.61) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=0.3), lty=2, lwd=0.2) +
  theme(legend.position="none",
        panel.spacing = unit(0.01, "cm"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_blank()) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    # Forces a tick at every 1,000,000 bp
    breaks = breaks_width(1e6), 
    # Converts 1000000 to "1", 2000000 to "2", etc.
    labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  #theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())+ 
  labs(x="Position (Mb)", y=expression(atop(Res~vs.~Sens,(Weighted~F[st]))))

library(patchwork)
combined_plot <- (top / bottom) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))


ggsave(glue::glue('{GWAS_results}/fst_graph.svg'),plot = combined_plot, height = 4.5, width = 10)
```
